Read the provenance of a node's current artifact

Source: R/provenance.R
bg_node_pad.Rd

Resolves node_id to the execution that produced the artifact it currently uses: its predicted fingerprint selects the cached artifact, and the most recent succeeded job that produced that artifact at that fingerprint is the representative execution. The representative can belong to another node that shares the fingerprint (cache reuse), because the node's artifact is that execution's output.

Usage

bg_node_pad(project, node_id)

Arguments

project

A bg_handle.

node_id

A node id.

Value

The execution's provenance list with its job_id, or NULL when the node has no fresh artifact or the artifact has no recorded provenance: executions from before provenance was recorded, and executions whose capture failed (their job records capture_error). Run the node, or re-execute it with bg_run(project, rerun = node_id), to record one.

Details

The returned provenance records the execution's own output (artifact_ref), its fingerprint, the inputs passed to the executor (in order), what it consumed (D input ids, the check subject, and data_files with SHA-256 hashes taken before the executor ran), the effective settings read back from the result, the environment of the process that ran it, and the pad snapshot (P/A/D components with SHA-256 digests, or NULL when the node kind has no complete bg_register_node_kind() pad declaration). For kinds that declare a pad, file-backed data counts only as a non-empty regular file hashed before the run at the identical path, and the Stan source and its includes must exist; when that rule is violated, or the Stan source or a consumed file changed while the executor ran, pad is NULL and capture_error says why.
